name: Common-Core Singletons
definition: On $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$, let $\mathcal C^{\cap}_n=\{\{0,i\}:1\leq i\leq n\}$. Thus every concept contains the common coordinate $0$ and one private coordinate.
comments: A common-core lift of the singleton class. Projecting away the common coordinate recovers the $n$ singleton concepts.
